# Chef Knife — Premium Chef Knife Sets, Hand-Forged in Sialkot, Pakistan

> Chef Knife is the direct-to-consumer brand of **Pakistan Knife Factory (PKF)**,
> an old-line family-run knife workshop located in the Small Industrial Area of
> Sialkot, Pakistan. PKF has been hand-forging blades in Sialkot for decades.
> We sell premium chef knife sets directly from the factory, free delivery across
> Pakistan, paid online via EasyPaisa or JazzCash.

## Products

We sell two premium chef knife sets, both priced at **PKR 4,900 delivered** anywhere in Pakistan.

- [Sapphire Chef Knife Set](https://chefknife.pk/chef-knife-set-sapphire.html) —
  Full-tang 8-inch chef knife + 3.5-inch paring knife. Hand-poured sapphire-blue
  acrylic resin handles, triple-riveted. Mirror-polished high-carbon stainless
  steel blades. Presented in a satin-lined black gift box.

- [Teak Chef Knife Set](https://chefknife.pk/chef-knife-set-teak.html) —
  Full-tang 8-inch chef knife + 3.5-inch paring knife. Natural teak wood handles
  (each piece unique), triple-riveted. Mirror-polished high-carbon stainless steel
  blades. Presented in a satin-lined black gift box.

Both sets include: an 8-inch chef knife, a 3.5-inch paring knife, and a black
satin-lined presentation gift box. Both are forged, ground, polished and
inspected by hand at our Sialkot workshop.
